blocks.text: 9 February: free day and optional trip to Angra dos Reis

The day is entirely yours.

You could visit the Botanical Garden or Parque Lage, explore Ipanema's galleries, shops and cafés, or spend time by the ocean.

You can also book a trip to Angra dos Reis.

This excursion is outside the base price.

There are two ways to get there: a helicopter flight of about 40 minutes or a drive by car.

In Angra dos Reis, take a boat trip between the islands of the Costa Verde.

At the stops, you can swim or snorkel among the fish.

Lunch is on one of the islands.
Shady street lined with trees and café tables in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Rio de Janeiro: pavement café seating under the trees
10 February: flight to Iguaçu, the Brazilian side of the falls and Macuco Safari

After breakfast, transfer to the airport.

The flight to Foz do Iguaçu is paid for separately.

On arrival, your guide will meet you and take you to your hotel.

Stay in a Junior Suite at Belmond das Cataratas, with breakfast included.

The hotel is inside the national park.

Guests can visit the falls before the park opens or after it closes, when there are fewer visitors.

Then set out on a tour of the Brazilian side of the falls.

The cascades gradually come into view between the trees.

You hear the roar first, then see the mist rising above the gorge.

At the Devil's Throat, spray reaches the boardwalks.

The Brazilian side offers a sweeping view of the falls.

**Macuco Safari at Iguaçu Falls, Brazil**

The Macuco Safari follows the walk.
